comment: Negative checks for scripts/formal/refdiff-harness.py --ci, run by scripts/formal/check-refdiff-negative.sh: each wraps the real binary with scripts/formal/refdiff-mutate.py (env OP, PTR, TO, OWNER, SEV) on one case here, and --ci must exit 1. Each case must also pass --ci with the unmodified binary.

checks.why: A real $ref record inside an alias whose siblings carry content (A = {$ref: A, type, properties}) is not Q1.
A $ref record naming an alias loop L that the use does not reach is not Q1.
Renaming a real $ref record's value to an unreached loop L does not make it Q1.
P is reached through properties.a (a component record) and inlined under default (a Review record at the use, #186): flipping the component record's verdict is caught.
Q is reached through the grammar and inlined under D.default: flipping the grammar record's verdict is caught.
P is reached through the grammar and inlined, through U, under default: flipping the grammar record's verdict is caught.
An owner that is a pure alias loop qualifies only when the use reaches it; L is unused.
L is a reachable loop, but no reference to it sits at /properties/zz in A on either side (the structural check).
Dropping the Breaking component record and the Review record inlined under default is caught.
As g1, with P inlined through U under default.
The Review record inlined under default (/default/nullable, the reference's sibling) rated Breaking is a verdict mismatch.
A record outside the schema grammar (#186: default) is compared like any other: dropping it is caught.
A record inlined under a component's default (D, reached through properties.d) is compared at that component: dropping it is caught.
#186: a change reached through if is Review; rating it Breaking, as main did before the fix, is caught.
#186: the Review record at /if/type is required, as before #182.
